compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Discovered during the Step 7 parity census for bug `5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`. On Jira Data
Center the outbound comment send path applies **no length fit at all**, so an
over-length comment is handed to Jira unfitted.

## Evidence

- `adapters/jira_datacenter/_links.py:82-84` — `_CommentsMixin.add_comment` passes `body`
  straight to `self._client.add_comment(remote_id, body)`; no fit, no sanitize.
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:493-494` — `JiraDCBackend.add_comment` is a bare
  delegate to that transport.
- `_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment` (`backend.py:259-273`) — the send-side sanitizer with
  its operator warning — has **no production caller**. `grep -rn "\.sanitize_comment(" src tests`
  returns test files ONLY (`test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py`,
  `test_dc_backend_characterization.py`, `test_backend_characterization.py`). The same is
  true for Cloud's `_JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment`.
- `fit_comment` (the differ-side twin) IS wired, via `outbound_comments._diff_comments`.
  So the comparison half of the convergence pair is live and the SEND half is not.

## Why it matters

Bug `6afc-20ee-84e5-4dd5` established that Jira exits 0 on an over-length comment
rejection, so the comment never lands and is re-emitted every pass — the outbound
comment-sync loop. DC's ceiling is lower than Cloud's and is deployment-resolved
(`comment_max_chars()`, bug `049e`), which makes an unfitted DC body more likely to be
rejected, not less. `test_dc_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py` pins the CONTRACT
but not the WIRING.

Note this is NOT bug 5931's mechanism — with no truncation on the DC path there is
nothing to cut the RECONCILER_MARKER off. It is the mirror-image gap found by the same
census: Cloud truncates and loses the marker; DC does not truncate at all.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The DC outbound comment send path fits the body through the deployment-resolved
      ceiling before handing it to the transport.
- [ ] A test drives the DC send path with an over-length body and asserts the wire value
      is within `comment_max_chars()` (RED on current code).
- [ ] Cloud's `sanitize_comment` is either wired or removed — a send-side sanitizer with
      no caller is a false assurance.
compiled_state.title: Jira DC outbound comments are never length-fitted: sanitize_comment has no production caller
